description: Resolve the authenticated FreshBooks user and their identifiers: accountId (alphanumeric, used by accounting and payments endpoints), businessId (integer, used by projects and time tracking) and businessUuid. The three are not interchangeable — using the wrong one returns a 404 rather than a useful error. When the identity belongs to several businesses, `businesses` lists them all; unless FRESHBOOKS_BUSINESS_ID picks one, writes are refused.
name: freshbooks_get_identity
